scope: First scout candidate as the representative sample of the teal and cream side-view character family; the medic and family continuity are reviewed in a later connected plan.

contract.intent: Right-facing side-view scout with a continuous #25354a outline, flat teal body and cream features; owner-confirmed canvas, palette, alpha, view and sampling, expert-proposed facing and scout landmarks.

criteria.check: The candidate file is a single-frame 32 by 32 pixel PNG.
Every pixel has alpha 0 or 255; no fractional alpha pixels.
Every opaque pixel is exactly one of #25354a, #56b5bc or #f4dda2.
criteria.basis: Owner confirmed the teal and cream palette and the reference's dark outline; exact values are measured from the references.

criteria.check: Viewed at native scale and at integer enlargement, the figure's outer silhouette is bounded by a continuous #25354a outline with the same edge treatment as reference.png; no teal or cream pixel touches transparency.
criteria.basis: Owner chose the reference's dark outline; reference.png shows the treatment.
criteria.scope: This candidate at native and enlarged views

criteria.check: The character is drawn in profile for a side-view game, standing on a single ground line inside the canvas with its feet and head fully within the 32x32 bounds.
criteria.basis: Owner chose side view for a side-view game.
criteria.scope: This candidate at native and enlarged views

criteria.check: At native 32x32 on a light and a dark background the sprite reads as a scout character: at least one scout landmark (hood or cap, or pack) is distinguishable in silhouette or cream accent.
criteria.basis: Expert proposal for a readable scout role; the owner named the role, PIXL proposed the landmarks.
criteria.scope: This sample candidate; the landmark list is a scoped proposal, not an owner rule

criteria.check: Teal and cream play the same roles as in the references: teal is the main body fill and cream marks the face or accents, with the dark value used only for the outline and interior separations.
criteria.basis: Expert continuity choice derived from the observed color roles in both references.
criteria.scope: This sample candidate; carried into family continuity later

sources.locator: Teal body, cream eyes, dark outline
